description: Use both grippers to sort one batch of mixed nuts and screws, placing nuts in the fixed left box and screws in the fixed right box.

left_hand.label: left_hand_sort_mixed_nuts_and_screws
left_hand.instruction: With the left gripper, repeatedly select and place visible nuts in the fixed left box and visible screws in the fixed right box.

left_hand.label: left_hand_finish_and_retreat_after_batch
left_hand.instruction: After the left gripper has no remaining item to sort, wait without disturbing the other gripper and retreat when the batch is complete.

right_hand.label: right_hand_sort_mixed_nuts_and_screws
right_hand.instruction: With the right gripper, repeatedly select and place visible nuts in the fixed left box and visible screws in the fixed right box.

right_hand.label: right_hand_finish_and_retreat_after_batch
right_hand.instruction: After the right gripper has no remaining item to sort, wait without disturbing the other gripper and retreat when the batch is complete.

atomic_actions.label: sort_mixed_nuts_and_screws_into_fixed_boxes
atomic_actions.instruction: Use both grippers concurrently to sort the entire mixed batch, placing every nut in the fixed left box and every screw in the fixed right box.

atomic_actions.label: confirm_batch_complete_and_retreat
atomic_actions.instruction: After the final item is released, leave no item in the central workspace, keep both boxes correctly sorted, and retreat both grippers before any human reset.
